Remark
[Comparison with fixed-quality necks] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0084 ↗ def:chow-iii-embedded-epsilon-neck 1. ch18:18.27\group Necks

Every embedded $\varepsilon $-neck with $\varepsilon \le \varepsilon (n)$ is also an embedded $\varepsilon (n)$-neck. Given fixed $(\varepsilon _0,k_0,L_0)$, sufficiently small $\varepsilon $ also guarantees the presence of an embedded neck of that fixed quality and length.
